changes.to: The record is brand-level ('DUCO'), and DUCO is the embodied-intelligence brand of SIASUN subsidiary Zhongke Xinsong (中科新松), so no single model's specs were written into the record. Maker product page for the 类人形 series: BR-MR73A wheeled humanoid and BR-DR73 half-body (fixed pedestal) share dual 7-DOF force-controlled arms with 630 mm working radius, +/-0.05 mm repeatability and 800 mm/s TCP speed; the table gives one variant 17 DOF (head 2, arms 7 x 2, waist 1) and 24 DOF (head 2, arms 7 x 2, waist 4, chassis 4) for the other, 5 kg per arm (8 kg with both), 800-1,450 mm or 800-2,000 mm working height, Orin AGX 200/275 TOPS, head depth camera plus front/rear torso cameras and microphone array, 1.2 m/s with laser SLAM and +/-5 mm docking, ROS 2 and Python SDK, one variant running continuously with no battery and the other giving about 6 h. CONFLICT: the maker's blog gives the BR-MR73A a 3 kg arm payload and 1.2 m/s while the product table gives 5 kg per arm / 8 kg dual, and the table's variant columns do not line up with the model names, so the per-model mapping is uncertain. The humanoid.guide figures (~30-35 DOF, ~150-160 cm, ~90-110 kg, 85,000 USD) are unverified and were not used.
DUCO (多可), SIASUN's embodied-AI brand, sells its humanoid line as the BR-MR73A wheeled humanoid and the BR-DR73 half-body robot, both built on the same dual 7-axis force-controlled arm platform.
